titulo_es: A text with several voices · Integrated reading B1

texto: In an integrated reading, first define what the question asks you. For a data, it seeks explicit evidence; for an inference, it combines clues and dismisses conclusions that the text does not hold.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.da: Artiklen gengiver både kommunens svar og naboernes kritik.
frases.es: El artículo reproduce tanto la respuesta del municipio como las críticas de los vecinos.
frases.en: The article reproduces both the response of the municipality and the criticism of the neighbors.

frases.da: Den viser, at parterne er enige om problemet, men ikke om løsningen.
frases.es: Muestra que las partes coinciden en el problema, pero no en la solución.
frases.en: It shows that the parts match the problem, but not the solution.
